SEO AUDIT

Synergy Dental Center — SEO audit

Five specific fixes, without changing approved client work.

104 sitemap URLs · 104 distinct HTML pages · two offices · read-only · October 7

01

The two offices and treatments share conflicting schema

69 pages contain legacy office-ID collisions, and 42 treatment pages repeat Product pricing and numeric Service names despite a newer separate-office graph.

  • Retire the duplicate legacy Dentist sources and84 inappropriate Product blocks; keep accurate #gillette/#sturgis Dentist graphs and genuine FAQs.
  • Use treatment titles and unique office-specific Service IDs; align provider biography references in the same schema package.
02

Unplayed testimonial videos download immediately

Three paused testimonial videos below the fold transferred 3.29 MB in a 15-second mobile observation before any scrolling or playback.

  • Set the three testimonial players to preload none and defer their sources until visibility or play; keep posters and controls.
  • Optimize the approved 5.64 MB hero loop with a lightweight mobile poster and stable initial video sizing, preserving quality.
03

Two confirmation pages can appear in search

/thank-you/ and /contact-us-post-submission/ are index-follow and listed in the XML sitemap despite serving only submission confirmation.

  • Set both confirmation pages to noindex and remove them from XML after the setting is applied.
  • Keep their URLs, completion messages, form destinations and conversion tracking working.

04

The financing card repeats exam information

The homepage Payment Options card repeats the biologic exam paragraph instead of explaining payment or financing.

  • Replace #text_block-107-10 with an approved short payment summary and a link to /financing-options/.
  • Keep the CareCredit/Cherry links and the original exam paragraph #text_block-58-10 unchanged.

05

Two retired feeds remain submitted

Search Console retains video-sitemap.xml and sitemap.rss with fetch errors, and both exact endpoints now return 404.

  • Remove only those two obsolete submissions after confirming retirement.
  • Keep the healthy current sitemap and working page/post/index aliases.

Fix order

Consolidate schema, stop avoidable pre-play downloads, then tidy confirmation indexing, payment copy and retired feeds.

  • Website: one schema package, source-gated media, two confirmation settings and the payment paragraph.
  • SEO: preserve current work and remove only the two retired submissions.

Preserve separate offices, approved tracking/forms and patient media. Available field LCP/CLS are good; INP is unavailable.
